case_study_packaging.headline: Advantia Health unlocks $716K in annual savings and a 3× ROI through Treya Partners’ rapid strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health—a fast-growing, PE-backed women’s health platform spanning 27 clinics—was purchasing everything from medical supplies to IT services at the clinic level with little central oversight. Fragmented data, entrenched incumbent relationships, and a lean corporate staff limited their ability to negotiate market-competitive pricing. With BlueMountain Capital expecting near-term EBITDA improvement, Advantia needed an expert partner to quickly surface savings and put disciplined procurement controls in place.
approach_summary: Analyzed $19 M in AP and P-card data to isolate $13.7 M of addressable spend across ten clinical, technology and indirect categories.
Renegotiated Athenahealth revenue-cycle fees—leveraging market benchmarks—to secure a 12.7% rate cut and $259 K in retroactive savings.
Ran competitive RFPs and consolidated medical-supply distribution to a single McKesson contract, capturing $157 K (14%) while preserving service continuity.
Converted outsourced per-scan sonography to an in-house staffing model, delivering $152 K (19%) in savings without disrupting patient throughput.
Instituted no-cost, behavior-based levers—including ≥5-unit IUD order minimums and enrollment in Bayer’s ‘Confidence in Coverage’ program—netting an additional $77 K.
top_levers: Purchasing-behavior policy changes (IUD order thresholds & manufacturer program enrollment)
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya Partners delivered $684,936 in finalized annual savings—with another $31,459 in late-stage review—amounting to a $716 K run-rate and more than triple the project’s $225 K fixed fee. First dollars were realized just 45 days after kickoff, and six categories are already accruing benefits. Beyond the financial impact, Advantia now has standardized ordering policies, streamlined distributor relationships, and a clear roadmap for ongoing procurement governance.
where_we_were_unique: Generated tangible savings within 45 days by targeting quick-win levers such as IUD ordering policies and manufacturer rebate programs.
Secured retroactive pricing concessions from entrenched vendors—delivering savings without operational disruption or costly system changeovers.
Combined deep healthcare category expertise with hands-on data cleansing to overcome fragmented spend data and supplier resistance.
Provided a turnkey sourcing team that allowed Advantia’s lean staff to focus on patient care while still achieving a 3× return on consulting fees.
